snippet.title: In the Van - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
In the Van is a cozy post-apocalyptic survival game where your van is your home, your shelter, and your key to survival. Scavenge, craft, and uncover the stories the dead left behind. 

Create your own survivor and take on a hostile world from the safety of your mobile base. Scavenge for resources, craft essential gear, and upgrade your van while navigating PvE dangers. Recover abandoned digital devices to uncover hidden clues, and make your shelter a place worth coming back to.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4664840/In_the_Van/

Developer: Cosmic Tofu
X: https://x.com/Team_CosmicTofu
